label: Every contingent being has esse distinct from essence, from unconditional essentialism
description: A new support bundle for #1870's B6: unconditional essentialism decomposes B6 into essence-grounds-necessity and the essential-existence reading of esse = essence. Not a transcription: neither premise mentions contingency. Establishes no premise; existence-conditional essentialism rejects the second premise for any being whose absence is representable (controls, law 3), which is exactly the standing rival's position.
